scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); function copy(src,dest){fs.mkdirSync(dest,{recursive:true});for(const e of fs.readdirSync(src,{withFileTypes:true})){const s=path.join(src,e.name);const d=path.join(dest,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())copy(s,d);else fs.copyFileSync(s,d)}} copy(path.join('.next','static'),path.join('.next','standalone','.next','static')); copy(path.join('public'),path.join('.next','standalone','public')); console.log('Static files copied to standalone');"
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently "npm run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && npm run electron"
scripts.electron:build: npm run build && npm run postbuild && electron-builder
scripts.electron:build:win: npm run build && npm run postbuild && electron-builder --win
